topic: Granting GitHub access and project status
summary_markdown: The conversation covered two main points: a request for demographic data by the end of the week, and granting repository access. [p1] requested that GitHub read-only access be provided to 'Oksana' for the `allunite/jobs` repository. After confirming that read access was sufficient for now (though write access might be needed later), it was noted that Oksana is a data scientist but may not be in the correct group within the system.
decisions: Read-only GitHub access to `allunite/jobs` will be granted to Oksana.
action_items: Provide read-only GitHub access to `allunite/jobs` for Oksana.
Follow up on the demographic data request by end of week.
